column1: # Doc word budgets — the single source for how long an agent-loadable doc may be.
# Consumed by scripts/gen-docs.sh (the `docs-check` lane; `./boga docs budgets`
# prints every doc's count). Budgeted docs are AGENTS.md and every persistent doc
# reachable from it; words are whitespace-separated tokens (`wc -w`). Rules for
# a doc over its budget: docs/specs/README.md ("Doc budgets").
# Rows (tab-separated):
#   budget   <doc|*>  <words>   a doc's limit; `*` is the default for the rest
#   exempt   <prefix>           docs under this prefix are reported, not budgeted
#   corpus   <dir/>   <words>   a directory loaded whole: its persistent docs'
#                               combined limit, on top of each doc's own
#   ceiling  <doc>    <words>   grandfathered: the doc was over budget when the
#                               budgets landed. It may not grow; `./boga docs gen`
#                               lowers it as the doc shrinks and drops it once the
#                               doc fits. Never add or raise one without the
#                               operator's agreement.
budget
budget
budget
